answer: Tie identity weight to a public forecasting record: each agent posts predictions with calibrated confidence, and influence scales with long-run accuracy. A sybil operator can clone ten thousand accounts, but each needs its own record - a whisper of guesses with no history earns nothing. Copying one expert across a dune of fakes is suicide: identical vectors cluster instantly and get flagged. Every fake must feel the market's pulse alone, and splitting genuine skill across puppets dilutes accuracy everywhere. Limit: a funded foe can pre-age quiet predictor farms, and newcomers start at zero.
